13from PySide6.QtCore import QAbstractTableModel, QModelIndex, Qt, Slot

16class TimeSeriesTableModel(QAbstractTableModel):
17 """Simple two-column table model for QtCharts VXYModelMapper.
18
19 Column 0 -> X (seconds)
20 Column 1 -> Y (value)
21 """
22
23 def __init__(self, max_points: int = 600) -> None:
24 super().__init__()
25 self._max_points = max(100, int(max_points))
26 self._points: list[tuple[float, float]] = []
27
28 def rowCount(self, parent: QModelIndex = QModelIndex()) -> int: # noqa: N802
29 if parent.isValid():
30 return 0
31 return len(self._points)
32
33 def columnCount(self, parent: QModelIndex = QModelIndex()) -> int: # noqa: N802
34 if parent.isValid():
35 return 0
36 return 2
37
38 def data(self, index: QModelIndex, role: int = Qt.DisplayRole):
39 if not index.isValid() or role not in (Qt.DisplayRole, Qt.EditRole):
40 return None
41
42 x_val, y_val = self._points[index.row()]
43 return x_val if index.column() == 0 else y_val
44
45 @Slot(float, float)
46 def append_point(self, x_value: float, y_value: float) -> None:
47 if len(self._points) >= self._max_points:
48 self.beginRemoveRows(QModelIndex(), 0, 0)
49 self._points.pop(0)
50 self.endRemoveRows()
51
52 row = len(self._points)
53 self.beginInsertRows(QModelIndex(), row, row)
54 self._points.append((float(x_value), float(y_value)))
55 self.endInsertRows()
56
57 @Slot()
58 def clear(self) -> None:
59 if not self._points:
60 return
61 self.beginResetModel()
62 self._points.clear()
63 self.endResetModel()
